data.one_liner: Configurator for controlled Flutter app initialization, error handling, and splash screen management.
data.what_it_does: Provides a robust entry point structure to initialize asynchronous services before app startup, handle Dart and Flutter errors safely, and display custom splash screens without blocking.
use_when: You need to initialize asynchronous services like Firebase before running the app widget tree.
You want centralized error handling for uncaught exceptions and Flutter errors.
You want to show a custom splash screen during asynchronous pre-initialization.
avoid_when: Your application relies on standard minimal runApp setups without complex pre-initialization.
You are using a lower Flutter version than 3.10.0 (unless using package version 2.1.2 and below).
strengths: Simplifies safe zone configuration and error management.
Allows pre-initialization of data before building the main app widget.
Provides independent debug and release error screens.
weaknesses: Introduces custom abstractions over standard Flutter entry point logic.
Requires updating configuration patterns when upgrading major package versions.
data.setup_notes: Replace standard main() implementation with appRunner configuration.
